title: Everyday Conversations

questions.explanation: 'He' takes 'wakes' in the simple present. 'Usually' goes before the main verb here.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.prompt: I remember when I ___ my first job.
questions.explanation: A first job began in the past, so use 'started'.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

application.prompt: Tell a friend about a favorite place, then ask two natural follow-up questions.
checklist: I used a useful expression from these lessons.
I compared the meaning with the example; my wording can be different.
application.modelResponse: I enjoy visiting the park because it's quiet. You might want to try it early in the morning. Where do you usually go to relax? [Pause for a reply.] What do you enjoy doing there?

completionRule: Attempt all five questions and review explanations

introduction.en: Practice asking follow-up questions, describing routines, sharing memories, and making recommendations.
